answer: Sybil resistance comes from a stake lock that releases only after a cooldown, so one operator cannot cheaply spin up replicas. Each new identity must post the same bond before its first attestation counts, so N identities cost N bonded units. Vote weight is stake-weighted, so to outvote honest validators an attacker needs more capital than the honest total, and that capital sits idle through unbonding where slashing can still fire. A wharf fee on every hull, trust fixed at the zenith of honest stake, and a dune of locked funds to climb again per clone.
